description: Archive a project (soft-delete — sets archived_at, no data removed). The project disappears from the default switcher list but its sessions/pkgs/todos remain on disk and can be restored by a later iyke_project_update if needed. Refuses to archive the built-in "Default" project. If the archived project was active, the shell falls back to Default automatically.

id.description: Slug of the project to archive.

name: iyke_project_archive
